review.headline_zh: 烩饭和韩牛最惊艳，蔬菜那道很一般
review.headline_en: The risotto and the hanwoo stole the show; the vegetable course fell flat
review.body_zh: 开场的鱼很鲜嫩；桃子那道说不清是什么，但很好吃。蔬菜（乳清）那道非常一般。松露烩饭松软可口，拌着底下的汤汁相当赞；铜壶浇汤的银鲳也不错。韩牛非常非常嫩，可惜量太少。甜品两道都有冰淇淋，冰淇淋确实做得好。
review.body_en: The fish early on was fresh and tender, and the peach course, whatever it was, was delicious. The vegetable (whey) course was very ordinary. The truffle risotto was soft and lovely with its sauce, a real highlight, and the pomfret in broth was good too. The hanwoo was incredibly tender but the portion was too small. Both desserts came with ice cream, and the ice cream was genuinely good.
review.revisit_zh: 朋友来首尔会带去，自己不会再去
review.revisit_en: Yes with visiting friends; not again on my own
